name: Retro Windows
description: Windows 95 chrome: beveled gray windows, navy gradient title bars, MS Sans Serif system font, Press Start 2P pixel accents. Bevel-based depth — no blurred shadows. CRT scanline overlay. Dense application-UI composition. Retro status colors (green/red/yellow/cyan) with fixed semantic meanings.
